scenarios.scenario: Analysis — Diagnose the root cause of the compiler errors

rubricScores.criterion: Recognized that the 'not defined' (FS0039) errors occur ONLY on the net472 target framework
Identified the undefined symbols as .NET-only runtime hot-reload/loading APIs: MetadataUpdater, AssemblyLoadContext, System.Runtime.Loader
Explained that net472 (.NET Framework 4.7.2) lacks these APIs, hence the FS0039 errors
Recognized FS0072 (type-inference) errors as a cascade downstream of the undefined symbols, not independent bugs
Noted that a small number of net10.0 errors (FS0001 type mismatches) are a separate, real problem

scenarios.reasoning: The agent correctly diagnosed the root cause: HotReload test files using .NET Core-only APIs are compiled unconditionally against net472, causing the vast majority of the 170 errors. The analysis is well-structured with a clear table of missing symbols, a good explanation of why they're missing, and a practical fix suggestion. The agent handled tool failures (file not found errors) gracefully and adapted its approach. Minor weaknesses include not explicitly naming FS0072 as cascade errors and not identifying the net10.0 errors as FS0001 specifically. The 17 tool calls in 101 seconds was reasonably efficient given the complexity.
